about.first: kugorang is an independent app and game business founded and run by Hyeonwoo Kim. Its products include Fillday, 달빛 고물상, and CakeTogether.
about.second: Fillday is a planner for schedules, tasks, and reflections; 달빛 고물상 is a character idle game in development; CakeTogether is an app concept for preparing celebrations together. Hyeonwoo leads product planning, design, and development.

caketogether.headline: Prepare a gift together. Keep the wishes.
caketogether.description: An app concept that brings birthday gift pledges and wishes together in one place. Money and gifts would be exchanged outside the app.
meta.caketogether.title: CakeTogether · An app concept by kugorang
meta.caketogether.desc: A concept for birthday gift planning, contribution pledges and celebration cards, without money transfers.
cake.note: This is a service concept, not an available app. Its name, features and release schedule have not been finalized.
cake.boundary.title: Record a pledge, without transferring money.
cake.boundary.desc: The idea is to record “I plan to contribute this much.” Collecting, holding, transferring or settling gift money, purchasing gifts and arranging delivery are outside the service scope.
cake.steps.title: The experience we are exploring.
cake.step1.title: Prepare together
cake.step1.desc: The proposed flow starts with a gift, a target and a deadline, followed by a shared link to invite friends.
cake.step2.title: Record pledges and wishes
cake.step2.desc: Friends could record, edit or cancel their own pledge before the deadline, or simply leave a birthday wish without an amount.
cake.step3.title: Keep the memories
cake.step3.desc: Even if the target is not reached, a celebration card could keep the wishes whose authors agreed to share them.
cake.privacy.title: Sharing would be a personal choice.
cake.privacy.desc: The proposed design keeps individual amounts hidden from other participants and asks separately for consent to share names and messages on a card. This would not guarantee complete anonymity.
cake.scope: The concept uses Flutter. Features and the order of web and mobile releases are still being considered.
